raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Customers moved to the new CRM (change note 2026-01-15) now carry region codes '01'-'04' instead of region names, so silver_customers contains codes and gold_region_daily splits regions wrongly. raw_region_map gives a complete, one-to-one mapping for all four codes, so the correct region names can be derived.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = trim(m.region_code)"}}
